title: Multi-Region DR vs RPO/RTO
scenario: Solstice Ferries takes bookings for 22 routes from a single Region, and a rehearsal after a near-miss set the targets: no more than 5 minutes of bookings may be lost, and service must be back within 30 minutes of losing the Region. The finance director will not fund any continuously running application servers in the recovery Region, only stored data. Production peaks at 96 vCPUs of application servers. In last year's rehearsal the recovery attempt stalled because the recovery Region would not launch more than a small number of servers.
constraints: Do not claim live AWS experience
Finance funds no continuously running application servers in the recovery Region
The recovery procedure is rehearsed every quarter
The operations lead requires the recovery Region to reach full production capacity of 96 vCPUs
requiredArtifact: Architecture decision record + diagram notes + cost assumptions

rubric.label: Why live lab was unsuitable documented
The chosen strategy meets the 5-minute data-loss and 30-minute recovery targets and is the cheapest that does
Capacity of 96 vCPUs in the recovery Region is arranged ahead of a disaster

constraint_reason: Service unavailable or not disposable in a personal same-day lab
